text:
anya_csm: FYI — Peregrine Health hit a hard blocker on their SIG export. They keep getting 401s from the keystore export API when trying to produce audit evidence. Compliance deadline is EOW Friday. Need triage + ask for possible extension if we can't repro quickly. https://redwood.app/customers/peregrine

samir_support: Can you paste the exact request/response they sent? Correlation ID would be ideal so I can trace logs.

anya_csm: Pasted from customer (sanitized) — they included the curl and response: 
```bash
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export/keystore" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rk_live_*****" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"export_type":"keystore","format":"sig"}'
```
Response snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: abc123-req-98765

{"error":"invalid_client","message":"keystore export requires HSM attestation"}
```

samir_support: Thanks. :eyes: That message suggests the attestation check failed server-side. Will check our HSM connector logs for request id `abc123-req-98765`.

oliver_infra: Noted — I see a cert rotation job completed recently for hsm-prod-cluster (rotation job id rot-20231122-42) around 1719198015. Deploy-bot shows cert update to hsm-client. There's a small window where edge proxies might still have old certs bound.

deploy-bot: auto-rotated hsm-client cert for hsm-prod-cluster at 1719198015 (rotation id rot-20231122-42).

oliver_infra: Immediate mitigation: restart the hsm-connector in the region for Peregrine (eu-west-1). Command: `sudo systemctl restart redwood-hsm-connector` on connector hosts. That should reload the pushed cert and re-establish attestation.

luis_security: If we restart, we need to capture attestation success events to provide to the customer for the SIG evidence: timestamped logs showing attestation handshake, `attest_token` present, and the `export_allowed` audit entry. We also need to redact key material. I'll need those log lines attached to the questionnaire response.

samir_support: I'm pulling logs now for `abc123-req-98765`. Preliminary grep shows `attestation_failed` at 2023-11-22T14:20:13Z from connector-host-07. Attestation error: `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` 

oliver_infra: That aligns with the rotation gap. I'll coordinate a restart on connector-host-07 and host-08 in eu-west-1.

nina_compliance: For the SIG deliverable: if we can't produce automated export in the time window, Compliance can perform a manual signed export (internal process) and provide a notarized PDF with the same metadata. That is slower and requires exec approval. What's the ETA for infra restart?

oliver_infra: ETA 6–12 minutes to restart both hosts and validate attestation logs. I'll post back with grep snippets.

samir_support: After restart I'll re-run the export (same curl) using a test service token and capture full headers/response. Will attach scrubbed logs. If restart doesn't fix it we'll escalate to HSM vendor support.

anya_csm: Customer said they'd accept a short extension if we need it — asked for 72 hours max. I'll confirm in writing once we know outcome. Please also cc legal if we go manual.

luis_security: Opening INFRA ticket to track evidence collection and compliance sign-off: INFRA-3921. Assigning to oliver_infra + samir_support. We should include: (1) attestation logs, (2) x-request-id mapping, (3) redacted export audit record, (4) timeline note about cert rotation.

oliver_infra: Restart done on host-07 and host-08 at 1719201100. Quick smoke shows new attestation handshake succeeded: `attestation_success: true` for request id `abc123-req-98765` at 2023-11-22T14:31:40Z.

samir_support: Re-ran the curl with a scrubbed token; response now 200 and we got a signed artifact placeholder (not the key material):
```json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: abc123-req-98765

{"export_id":"exp-20231122-0007","status":"signed_ready","artifact_url":"https://s3.redwood-cust/peregrine/exp-20231122-0007.sig"}
```
I'll attach the log lines and the attestation snippet to INFRA-3921. :thumbsup:

nina_compliance: Great — once artifacts are in S3 we can pull and notarize for the SIG form. I'll wait for your attachment and then draft the bespoke answer for the questionnaire.

anya_csm: Customer notified and confirmed 72-hour extension. I'm emailing Legal and Sales now with the update.

luis_security: I'll draft the log excerpt template we'll include in the SIG package (redaction checklist + required fields). Samir/Oliver please add raw lines to the JIRA and mark `security_review_needed` when done.

samir_support: Done — INFRA-3921 updated with logs, cURL outputs, X-Request-Id mapping, and S3 artifact reference. Marked for security review.

anya_csm: Thanks team — saved the deliverable for customer. Closing loop with Peregrine after legal signs off.

oliver_infra: Follow-up action for us: add a short post-rotation checklist to the cert-rotation runbook to call `rolling-restart` on connectors in all regions. I'll make a PR.

luis_security: Filing a quick postmortem note in INFRA-3921 so the SIG answer has a clear timeline and RCA.

samir_support: If anything else shows up I'll ping here. Good job everyone.
